strategies.pullback: Signal close above SMA200, Wilder RSI2 <= 20, 3-session return < 0
strategies.reclaim: Signal close crosses above EMA20, EMA50 > EMA200, 63-session return > 0
strategies.breakout: Signal close above previous 20-session high, volume >= 1.2 times prior 20 mean, close above SMA200

execution: Signal known at prior close; enter at following regular-session closing auction, only if auction price <= prior close + 0.5 prior ATR14. Limit-on-close proxy; never treat an earlier intraday touch as a fill.
risk: Symmetric take profit and stop at 2 prior ATR14 from actual auction fill. Hold at most 20 subsequent sessions. Gap through stop fills at open; same-bar ambiguous ordering is stop first. No re-entry while a same-symbol same-rule trade is open.
baseline: Same ticker, LOC ceiling, symmetric ATR exits and nonoverlap convention; only close above SMA200, no short-term signal. Descriptive holdout comparison, not a new candidate.
selection: Before reading 2024+ trade outcomes, rank TODAY signal-active combinations by development Wilson 95% win-rate lower bound, requiring >=20 discovery trades, >=12 validation trades, positive mean return in each, and development mean win / abs(mean loss) >=0.8. Current quote must be at or below LOC ceiling. Lock up to 3 different symbols. No replacement after test outcomes are opened.
acceptance: Final test >=20 nonoverlapping completed trades, win rate >=65%, one-sided Bonferroni family-adjusted Wilson lower bound >50%, positive mean, profit factor >=1.3, mean win / abs(mean loss) >=0.8, and mean-return 95% block-bootstrap lower bound >0. At most 3 locked finalists; no guaranteed current-trade probability.
scope_limitations: Current surviving ETF/stock list, not a point-in-time all-market universe. Historical test has not been inspected by this protocol, but the conversation has already observed some CLS/QQQ/SMH return history. Not an independent production validation. Candidate count and all failures will be retained. This is a repeated use of previously inspected historical data, not a new untouched test. No claim of independent certification.
